## About
Bon Auto Body is a family owned business, and generations of customers in the Twin Cities Metro Area have trusted us for honest, professional service. We know an accident is disruptive, so we try to get you back in your own car as soon as we can.
Our people tend to stay. We have had very little turnover over the years, and every employee is I-CAR certified and keeps up with continuing education.
We are part of this neighborhood too. We belong to the local Chamber of Commerce and the Rotary Club of Richfield, support local kids sports programs, and put in volunteer hours where we can.

## Services
- Collision repair: Full body shop service for cars and trucks after an accident, from the first estimate to the final paint.
- Frame and unibody straightening: Our frame equipment and computerized measuring bring your vehicle back to the manufacturer's original specifications, so it drives the way it should.
- Computerized paint color matching: Dupont paint products, modern application systems and oven baked drying work together so the new paint matches the old.
- PDR dent repair: For small dents and dings, we can often fix the panel without the cost and time of painting.
- Free online estimates: Fill out our online estimate form from home or work and we will contact you however you prefer. (Free)
- Free loaner cars: If you don't have rental coverage and have no car to drive after an accident, we offer free loaner cars.
- Rental car assistance: We work with all rental car companies, so you can pick the company and vehicle that suits you.
- Cleaning inside and out: When the repairs are finished, we clean your car inside and out before you pick it up.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to use the shop my insurance company picks?
A: No. You can choose your repair shop no matter who your insurance company is. In Minnesota, an insurer telling you otherwise is not allowed.

Q: Do you offer towing?
A: We do not tow ourselves, but we accept vehicles from any towing company. We recommend Chief's Towing. Just tell the driver to bring your car to Bon Auto Body.

Q: What days are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
